description: Defines tensor indexing utilities, including classes and functions for slices, tensor indices, and indexing operations in PyTorch's ATen library.

classes.name: TensorIndex
classes.description: Represents a tensor index, supporting various types like slices, integers, booleans, tensors, None, and ellipsis.

classes.name: Slice
classes.description: Represents a slice with start, stop, and step parameters for tensor slicing.

classes.name: EllipsisIndexType
classes.description: Represents an ellipsis index in tensor indexing.

methods.name: applySlice
methods.description: Applies a slice operation to a tensor along a specified dimension.

methods.name: applySelect
methods.description: Selects a specific index along a tensor dimension.

methods.name: boolToIndexingTensor
methods.description: Converts a boolean value to a tensor suitable for indexing.

methods.name: scalarToTensor
methods.description: Converts a scalar to a tensor, considering device and options.

methods.name: get_item
methods.description: Retrieves a tensor item based on provided indices, handling simple and advanced indexing.

methods.name: set_item
methods.description: Sets a tensor item based on provided indices, handling simple and advanced indexing.
